title: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect
provenance: Reported by JingKritsada (highball-db#87, 2026-09-16), Apple M3, macOS 27, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, rated 5 of 5 provisionally after a workaround: the game launches, displays and responds to input, extended play and frame rate not verified. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: An OpenGL game. On the stock engine it crashes at startup through a null OpenGL function pointer (GLEW's glClearDepthf, a function macOS's own OpenGL does not provide). The reporter got it running by placing Mesa's Windows OpenGL build (opengl32.dll and libgallium_wgl.dll from mesa-dist-win 26.2.0) beside the game's exe with a per-exe native override for opengl32, launched through Steam with sync off. That is a hand edit Highball does not ship; it points at the same OpenGL gap as Mewgenics and at Mesa as the way to close it. Performance was not measured and may be software rendering.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at startup with a page fault at address zero on every graphics mode (reported on an M3, macOS 27)
knownIssues.cause: reported from the disassembly: the game calls glClearDepthf through GLEW and Wine's macOS OpenGL has no such function, so the pointer is null
knownIssues.fix: workaround by hand: Mesa's Windows opengl32.dll and libgallium_wgl.dll next to DkkStm.exe with a native,builtin override for opengl32 on that exe. Not shipped by Highball yet
